messages:
Alex: pinging eng — PR #4356 ready but blocked by CI. integ/kv-evict-shard3 keeps failing. Merge window in ~30m. Can someone rerun or approve if we decide to skip that test? @Maya @Sam
CI-bot: Build 81234 failed on integ-kv-evict-shard3
  failed test: TestKVCacheEviction::TestLargeKeys
  exit code: 1
  log snippet: `kv_cache_test.go:214: expected 3 evictions, got 0`
Maya: on it, grabbing logs now :coffee:
Sam: quick context — has this been flaky recently? I can check history if helpful
Alex: I checked earlier, last 5 runs on that shard: 3 failures, 2 passes. pattern looks intermittent and correlated to shard3 under load
Jordan: can we do a targeted rerun instead of full CI? less noisy if we only rerun shard3
Maya: will run targeted. command I'm using: `/ci rerun --targeted shard=3 pr=4356` (buildkite)
Maya: rerun submitted — new build 81236
CI-bot: Build 81236 started (targeted: shard=3)
Maya: rerun passed on shard3. full CI still pending for other checks but shard issue resolved
Alex: excellent. note we need 2 approvers to merge. @Jordan can you give a +1 once you eyeball the changes?
Jordan: i'll take a quick look. if rerun green and no snapshot regressions, happy to approve :+1:
Sam: FYI if this flakes again we should mark the test flaky and open follow-up bug. I'll prepare a follow-up issue if we hit a second failure
Maya: full CI finished — all green except a tiny mac-smoke snapshot whitespace diff (rendered markdown). not functionally relevant
Sam: can you paste the diff?
Maya: `-"Title\n" +"Title \n"` — only trailing space change in one line
Jordan: fine to approve provided we note a snapshot-update task. can we include the snapshot PR in the description after merge?
Alex: merge window closes 16:00 UTC. if we miss it we'll hold until morning. prefer to merge now if maintainers agree
Maya: i've added a `chore/flake` follow-up ticket link in the PR body and tagged `needs-snapshot-update`
Jordan: +1 from me after ticket added
Sam: +1 from me as well, going to open the flaky-test issue and assign to eng-ml
Alex: great, please merge and backport to release branch once merged
Maya: merging now, will cherry-pick to release/1.3 afterwards
CI-bot: PR 4356 merged by Maya (merge commit: abc123)
Alex: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
